mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "Latest" scrapes the Ministry's current procurement-notices page (whatever is open right now, ~20 at a time). "Archive" walks the paginated historical archive of every notice ever published there (460+ going back to 2018).

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Caps how many notices are returned. For mode=latest this is effectively capped by however many are currently posted (~20). For mode=archive, the actor fetches as many archive pages as needed (starting from archiveStartPage) until this many records are collected or the archive ends.

archiveStartPage.title: Archive start page (mode=archive only)
archiveStartPage.description: Which archive page to start from (page 1 = most recent historical notices). Each page holds a variable number of notices (roughly 4-20).
